rejection_reason:
PARK (status parked), re-measured 2026-10-30. Infrastructure blocker, not a data judgement: neither the coordinator network nor an EU (Helsinki) worker can read the portal - api.data.gov.in refuses TCP from both, and the www edge returns 503 because it cannot reach its origin. DNS is correct on both networks (same A records via the local resolver and dns.google), so this is not the coordinator resolver artifact seen on other sources. Not a rejection: data.gov.in is a large live catalog and nothing about its data is known to be unusable; only access from every network this project controls is blocked.

2026-11-04 re-measurement (regional tick): the record's reopen condition (b) has FIRED - independent third-party evidence shows the portal publicly reachable again (Entireweb Status: 'Open Government Data Platform is operating normally right now (2 November 2026)', smooth 30-day trend; the publisher's own X account @DataPortalIndia announced 'The OGD Platform is operational now' on 2026-10-21 after the 2026-09-30 maintenance notice). But the route blocker is SHARPER, not resolved: from the coordinator on 2026-11-04 the apex and api hosts still refuse TCP (curl exit 7, 0.59/0.71 s) and the www Akamai edge returns 503 'Service Unavailable - Fail to connect' (edge cannot reach origin); the r.jina.ai reader vantage gets the identical refusal (net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED at apex, 503 at www); Wayback CDX shows the Internet Archive's own crawler received 403s on 2026-09-08/18. The portal serves some vantages (third-party monitor, search crawler) and refuses the classes this project can reach. GODL platform claims are now readable WITHOUT a live route via Wayback (see cpcb-aqi-exceedance, reopened 2026-11-04 on exactly that evidence). Status stays parked at route level.
next_action: Reopen condition (b) fired 2026-11-04 (third-party uptime evidence + publisher's own operational announcement) but every vantage this project controls is still refused (coordinator curl: apex/api TCP refusal, www edge 503 fail-to-connect; r.jina.ai reader: same; recorded 2026-11-04). The catalog enumeration therefore still cannot run from here. Remaining unlock, an operator step: add a worker location whose vantage can reach data.gov.in to config/local.json allowed_locations (currently hel1 only - hel1 is recorded-blocked), or point the project at a licence-bearing third-party mirror of the catalogue. GODL-India per-resource claims ARE verifiable meanwhile via Wayback snapshots of catalog pages (proved 2026-11-04 on the CPCB resource, see cpcb-aqi-exceedance). The CPCB GODL sub-item of the original reopen enumeration is DONE (read, quoted, cpcb reopened). Do not re-probe from the coordinator or hel1 before the location decision; on a new location, run the original enumeration: API-enabled datasets via the catalog API, task families absent from the bench EXCLUDING station-level air quality (cpcb owns it).
